errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите на секторите
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis contains the categories. The categories (sectors) are on the vertical axis, and the horizontal axis represents the percentage values.
The categories are not sorted alphabetically. They are sorted in ascending order based on their percentage values, from top to bottom.

The list of categories provided in the description is incomplete. It omits several sectors shown in the chart, including 'ИКТ, комуникации, софтуерен бизнес' (ICT, communications, software business), 'Транспорт' (Transport), and 'Строителство' (Construction).

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва процентите на скритата икономика
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the vertical axis shows percentages. The percentages are represented by the length of the horizontal bars and their labels, while the vertical axis lists the categories.

errors.text_span: с равномерно разположени интервали на всеки 5%, отбелязани на оста
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates features of the value axis. There is no visible axis line with tick marks or intervals; the percentage values are provided as data labels for each bar.
The description incorrectly states the range of the scale. The values on the chart go up to 82.6%, not 10.9%, which is the lowest value.
The lowest data value shown on the chart is 10.9%, not 0%.

errors.text_span: най-високата стълба е за „Ресторантьорство и обществено хранене“ (80,4%), а най-ниската е за „Индустрия (промишленост)“ (15,3%)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the categories with the highest and lowest values. The highest value is 82.6% for 'Строителство' (Construction), and the lowest value is 10.9% for 'ИКТ, комуникации, софтуерен бизнес' (ICT, communications, software business).
